title: The Seeds That Fly Like Helicopters
short_teaser: Maple seeds spin as they fall, slowing descent and carrying them away from the parent tree.
story: Maple seeds spin as they fall, slowing descent and carrying them away from the parent tree. A simple form can solve movement without a motor. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective by reminding us how much remains unseen. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: A simple form can solve movement without a motor. Wonder interrupts routine and restores perspective by reminding us how much remains unseen.
